product_overview: SoloDeskOS is an AI-powered operating system for solo operators that unifies lead discovery, client management, proposals, invoices, and onboarding into one workflow. It helps users move records through a 5-gate sales and delivery process from first contact to payment and onboarding.
core_goals: Search across leads, clients, proposals, and invoices from one place
Track and manage leads through the sales pipeline
Research leads and capture outreach, replies, and follow-ups
Create and send proposals and invoices
Manage clients, onboarding tasks, and supporting documents
Import leads in bulk from CSV files

features.name: User Login
features.description: Sign in with email and password to access the app.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email -> Enter password -> Submit login form -> See dashboard

features.name: Dashboard Overview
features.description: Review pipeline status, quota progress, and recent activity from the main dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View pipeline stage statistics -> View today's target quota -> View recent activity timeline -> Open a stage summary to filter leads

features.name: Global Quick Search
features.description: Search across leads, clients, proposals, and invoices from a single modal.
user_flows: Open quick search from the dashboard -> Type a business name, proposal identifier, or invoice number -> View categorized results -> Select a result -> Open the matching record
Open quick search from the dashboard -> Type a query -> Use keyboard navigation to move through results -> Select a result -> Open the matching record

features.name: Lead Management
features.description: Browse, search, filter, and prioritize leads in the lead list.
user_flows: Navigate to /leads -> View the lead table -> Filter leads by status -> Search for a business name -> Mark a lead as Today's Target -> See the target quota count update
Navigate to /leads -> View the lead table -> Select a lead row -> Open the lead detail page

features.name: Lead Detail and Outreach
features.description: View lead details, run research, manage outreach, log replies, book calls, and handle lead documents.
user_flows: Navigate to a lead detail page -> Review the lead snapshot and interaction history -> Run deep research -> View the updated research results -> Open the contact flow -> Draft an outreach message -> Confirm contact
Navigate to a lead detail page -> Open the reply log flow -> Record a client reply -> View the updated conversation history
Navigate to a lead detail page -> Open the call booking flow -> Enter the call agenda -> Confirm the booking -> See the call recorded in activity history
Navigate to a lead detail page -> Upload a document -> Preview or download the file -> Delete the document if needed
Navigate to a lead detail page -> Edit lead information -> Save changes -> See the updated lead details
Navigate to a lead detail page -> Move the lead to proposal stage -> See the lead status change
Navigate to a lead detail page -> Reactivate a lost lead -> Enter a reason -> Confirm reactivation -> See the lead status change to qualified

features.name: Proposal Builder
features.description: Create, edit, generate, save, and send proposals with AI assistance.
user_flows: Navigate to /proposals/builder -> Review proposal details and line items -> Edit the proposal content -> Save the proposal -> See the saved proposal state
Navigate to /proposals/builder -> Generate an AI draft -> Review the drafted content -> Edit the proposal if needed -> Save the proposal
Navigate to /proposals/builder -> Review the proposal -> Mark the proposal as sent -> See the send confirmation recorded

features.name: Invoice Builder
features.description: Create and manage invoices with line items, export, and payment confirmation.
user_flows: Navigate to /invoices/builder -> Review invoice details and line items -> Add a line item -> Edit a line item -> Remove a line item -> Save the invoice
Navigate to /invoices/builder -> Review the invoice -> Export the invoice as PDF -> Receive the exported file
Navigate to /invoices/builder -> Mark payment as received -> See the invoice status change to paid

features.name: Client Management
features.description: Browse clients, filter by stage, view client records, manage documents, and access linked proposals and invoices.
user_flows: Navigate to /clients -> View the client list -> Filter clients by stage -> Search for a client name -> Open a client record
Navigate to /clients/[id] -> View linked proposals and invoices -> Upload a document -> Preview or download the file -> Delete the document if needed
Navigate to /clients/[id] -> Create an invoice for the client -> Continue in the invoice builder

features.name: Client Onboarding Checklist
features.description: Track onboarding tasks and progress for a client.
user_flows: Navigate to /onboarding/[id] -> View onboarding checklist items -> Mark a task as completed -> See progress update

features.name: CSV Lead Import
features.description: Bulk import leads from a CSV file with column mapping and preview.
user_flows: Navigate to /import -> Upload a CSV file -> Map columns to lead fields -> Preview the mapped data -> Confirm the import
Navigate to /import -> Load a saved mapping template -> Review the mapped fields -> Confirm the import

features.name: Settings Management
features.description: Adjust app preferences such as quota, cadence, tone, theme, and credentials.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> Review current settings -> Change the daily target quota -> Change the follow-up cadence -> Change the tone preference -> Save settings
Navigate to /settings -> Change the theme -> Save settings
Navigate to /settings -> Reset settings to default -> See the defaults restored

features.name: AI Copilot
features.description: Open an assistant drawer for contextual help and suggestions.
user_flows: Open the copilot from the dashboard -> Type a question or request -> Review the AI response -> Close the drawer

routes.description: Admin login page with email and password

Lead list with filters, search, bulk actions, and Today's Target quota
Lead detail page with research, outreach, follow-up engine, gates, documents

Client detail with proposals, invoices, onboarding, documents
Proposal builder with AI draft generation and Gate 3 send confirmation
Invoice builder with line items, PDF export, Gate 5 payment confirmation
CSV import page for bulk lead upload with column mapping
App settings for quota, follow-up cadence, tone, theme, credentials
Client onboarding checklist with task completion tracking
Document preview page for uploaded files
Root redirect to login or dashboard
